Spec 07 First Match (godot-mvp) — semantic diff

Branch feature/godot-mvpBase 369a9f2Head ec6f78d Target mainDate 2026-11-21 Commits 8 (this spec's: 737de09..ec6f78d)Files 55 · +2505 / −146 Written by REVIEW: + CODE REVIEW: · Claude Opus 5.5

Summary

Spec 07 turns Play into a real match: the canyon of spec 06 without dummies, the player against three bots, a countdown, health bars, healing, knock-outs, a timer and a result screen; the dummy arena moves to a new Training button. The rules are pure and seeded, the scenes thin; 298 tests and the lint pass.

  • Play now starts a match; Training opens the unchanged dummy arena (S1, S12).
  • Bots see, chase, back off, aim with an error and wander; on easy they react later, miss more, shoot and walk slower (S2, S6, S11).
  • Every fighter has health, heals after 3 quiet seconds and is knocked out with a puff; a shot never hits its shooter (S3–S5).
  • The result screen shows Victory, Defeat with the place or Time's up, the fighter, Play again and Home (S8, S9).
  • Nothing is saved and no server is called; the README and architecture have doc slips (findings 1–4).

Recommendation: Approve with follow-ups — no Blocking finding; fix the two README / architecture errors (findings 1, 2) and decide findings 5–7 at close.

Spec context

2026_11_12_07_first_match_spec.md (issue #31) — statements S1–S16; Steps 1–7, all ✅ (1 match rules and settings, 2 bot brain, 3 fighters that can be hit, 4 match arena with bots, 5 match HUD, 6 result screen and Training on home, 7 final check, README and architecture). Decisions D1–D13. The device play-test (S13) stays with the author (spec 03, D6; Deferred Items).

Semantic diff

Why: Hack star can be played, but nothing shoots back and nobody wins. Spec 07 adds the first real match, a "last fighter standing" fight against bots like Showdown in Brawl Stars: health, healing, knock-outs, a countdown, a timer, a result screen, and Training on home for the dummy arena of spec 06. The numbers Mattia still has to choose are settings in one place.

Breaking: Play no longer opens the dummy arena: it starts a match; the dummy arena is now Training. Nothing saved changes; no server call. · Checks: 6 pass · 3 n/a · 0 fail

Author Q&A

Why does the match inherit arena.tscn instead of copying it?
D1: the canyon, the player, the camera, the sticks, Back and the FPS label stay one scene; Arena gets class_name and training (only then dummies); MatchArena adds bots, Match and the HUD. Training stays the spec 06 demo with its tests.
How are the bots tested without flaky randomness?
D5, D8: BotBrain and MatchArena take a RandomNumberGenerator that tests seed; the brain is pure (positions in, {move, aim} out), so sight, reaction, aim error and wandering are checked without a scene (16 tests), and the arena tests seed the match.
Can a fighter hit itself with its own shot?
No: Shot.launch takes the shooter and excludes its RID from every ray (D6); tested point-blank in test_fighter_health.gd. Fighters still do not block each other.
Does a match change saved progress or call the server?
No (D12, S16): match_settings and last_result are session only; trophies come with spec 08; server/ and ui/ are unchanged (git diff --stat 369a9f2..ec6f78d -- server ui is empty).

Highlights

1 · The end of a match: knock-outs, place, time up

hack_star_godot/game/match.gd:78-117 · 10db8ff · S5, S8, D4

78## Records a knock-out and ends the match when the player is out or only the player is left.
79func knock_out(index: int) -> void:
80 if phase == Phase.OVER or not _alive[index]:
81 return
82 _alive[index] = false
83 knock_out_order.append(index)
84 if index == 0:

92 var suffix: String = "th"

What changed: Knock-outs are recorded in order; the player's knock-out ends the match as a Defeat with fighters left + 1, the last bot's as a Victory; time up is a draw or, by setting, a Defeat. Why it matters: This is the rule S8 defines; spec 08 will give trophies from it. Check: The place at time up with time_up_result "defeat" is fighters_left(), the player counted: 4th with nobody out (finding 6).

2 · A bot's decision each frame

hack_star_godot/game/bot_brain.gd:55-79 · 09958ad · S2, S6, S11, D5

55## at most 1) and `aim` (unit direction to fire, or `Combat.NO_SHOTSentinel value — Vector2.INF marks "do not fire", the same value Combat.release_aim already returns.`). `opponents` are the live
56## fighters it may attack as `{at, in_bush}` with an optional `id` (the index otherwise);
57## `level` is one of `MatchSettings.LEVELS`.
58func think(now: float, me: Vector2, opponents: Array[Dictionary], level: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
59 var target: int = _nearest_visible(me, opponents, level["sight"])
60 if target < 0:
61 _target_id = null
62 return {"move": _wander(now, me), "aim": Combat.NO_SHOT}
63 var opponent: Dictionary = opponents[target]
64 var target_id: VariantVariant — GDScript's any-type; the target id is an int index or a caller's id, and null means no target. = opponent.get("id", target)
65 if target_id != _target_id:
66 _target_id = target_id
67 _react_at = now + float(level["reaction"])
68 _side = 1.0 if _rng.randf()RandomNumberGenerator — A seedable generator; one per match is shared by the brains, so a test with a fixed seed sees the same choices. < 0.5 else -1.0
69 wander_point = Vector2.INF
70 if now < _react_at:
71 return {"move": Vector2.ZERO, "aim": Combat.NO_SHOT}
72 var offset: Vector2 = opponent["at"] - me
73 var distance: float = offset.length()
74 var direction: Vector2 = offset.normalized() if distance > 0.0 else Vector2.UP
75 return {
76 "move": _fight_move(direction, distance),
77 "aim": _aim(direction, distance, level["aim_error"]),
78 }
79

What changed: The nearest visible opponent becomes the target; a new target first costs the level's reaction time; then the bot chases, backs off or sidesteps and aims with a random error. Why it matters: All of S2, S6 and S11 live here, and it is pure: tests seed the generator. Check: The reaction is measured on the wall clock the arena passes (Time.get_ticks_msec), like the healing and the cool-down.

3 · Wandering and the stuck check

hack_star_godot/game/bot_brain.gd:109-139 · 09958ad · S2, D5

109func _wander(now: float, me: Vector2) -> Vector2:
110 var distance: float = me.distance_to(wander_point) if wander_point != Vector2.INF else INF
111 if distance < _best_distance - PROGRESS_DISTANCE:
112 _best_distance = distance
113 _progress_at = now
114 if (
115 wander_point == Vector2.INF
116 or distance <= REACHED_DISTANCE
117 or now - _wander_since >= WANDER_SECONDS
118 or now - _progress_at >= STUCK_SECONDS
119 ):
120 wander_point = _free_point()
121 _wander_since = now
122 _progress_at = now
123 distance = me.distance_to(wander_point)
124 _best_distance = distance
125 if distance <= 0.0:
126 return Vector2.ZERO
127 return (wander_point - me) / distance
128
129
130func _free_point() -> Vector2:
131 var area: Rect2Rect2 — An axis-aligned rectangle; grow(-0.6) shrinks the arena bounds so random points keep clear of the border. = ArenaLayout.bounds().grow(-WANDER_CLEARANCE)
132 for i: int in WANDER_TRIES:
133 var point: Vector2 = Vector2(
134 _rng.randf_range(area.position.x, area.end.x),
135 _rng.randf_range(area.position.y, area.end.y)
136 )
137 if ArenaLayout.is_freePure layout data — The canyon as data (spec 06 D2), so a rule can ask "is this point free" without a physics query.(point, WANDER_CLEARANCE):
138 return point
139 return ArenaLayout.START

What changed: With nobody seen the bot walks to a random free point; a new one after reaching it, after 4 s, or after 1 s without getting 0.1 m closer. Why it matters: Rocks are not avoided by path-finding; the stuck rule is what keeps bots from pushing a wall forever. Check: _free_point falls back to START after 50 tries; ArenaLayout.is_free keeps 0.6 m from walls.

4 · The match loop

hack_star_godot/scenes/match_arena.gd:71-85 · 348a4dd · S1, S4, S11, D8

71func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
72 match_state.advance(delta)
73 super._physics_process(delta)super — Calls the inherited Arena method, so the player's input and camera stay exactly those of Training (D1).
74 _update_hud()
75 var now: float = Time.get_ticks_msec()Game clock — Milliseconds since the engine started; the same clock the arena's cool-down uses, so healing and reaction agree with firing. / 1000.0
76 var acting: bool = match_state.can_act()
77 for i: int in range(1, fighters.size()):
78 _drive_bot(i, now, acting)
79 if acting:
80 for fighter: Fighter in fighters:
81 fighter.heal_step(now, delta, _settings.heal_delay, _settings.heal_per_second)
82 if match_state.phase == Match.Phase.OVER:
83 _store_result_when_over()
84 _wait_for_the_end(delta)
85

What changed: Each physics frame: advance the Match, run the player's arena step, drive every bot, heal every live fighter while the fight is on, and handle the end. Why it matters: The countdown lock and healing are here; everything else is delegated to pure rules. Check: After OVER fighters stop and stop healing, but shots already flying still hit (finding 5).

5 · Driving a bot

hack_star_godot/scenes/match_arena.gd:125-150 · 348a4dd · S2, S6, S11, D8

125func _drive_bot(index: int, now: float, acting: bool) -> void:
126 var bot: Fighter = fighters[index]
127 var at: Vector2 = Vector2(bot.position.x, bot.position.z)
128 bot.model.set_see_throughSee-through — FighterModel swaps in alpha copies of its materials (spec 06 D11); now for every fighter in a bush (S6).(ArenaLayout.in_bush(at))
129 if not acting or bot.knocked_out:
130 bot.input_direction = Vector2.ZERO
131 return
132 var choice: Dictionary = _brains[index - 1].think(now, at, _opponents_of(index), _level)
133 bot.input_direction = choice["move"]
134 var aim: Vector2 = choice["aim"]
135 if aim != Combat.NO_SHOT:
136 fire_from(bot, aim, Combat.COOLDOWN * float(_level["cooldown"]))Cool-down factor — Bots fire through the player's own fire path with a longer cool-down per level (D3), so easy bots shoot more slowly (S11).
137
138
139## The live fighters bot `index` may attack: the player and, when bots fight each other, the
140## other bots.
141func _opponents_of(index: int) -> Array[Dictionary]:
142 var opponents: Array[Dictionary] = []
143 for i: int in fighters.size():
144 var other: Fighter = fighters[i]
145 if i == index or other.knocked_out or (i > 0 and not _settings.bots_fight_each_other):
146 continue
147 var at: Vector2 = Vector2(other.position.x, other.position.z)
148 opponents.append({"id": i, "at": at, "in_bush": ArenaLayout.in_bush(at)})
149 return opponents

What changed: Each live bot is see-through in a bush, gets the live opponents it may attack (only the player when bots do not fight each other), walks where its brain says and fires through the arena's fire path. Concepts glossary

CollisionObject3D
The base class of physics bodies; any fighter (a CharacterBody3D) can be the shooter.
Cool-down factor
Bots fire through the player's own fire path with a longer cool-down per level (D3), so easy bots shoot more slowly (S11).
Default argument
Old callers keep the 0.35 s; bots pass a longer one.
Deferred call
Changing the scene inside _ready is unsafe; call_deferred runs it at the end of the frame.
Disabled collision
The shape leaves the physics space, so shots and other fighters pass through a knocked-out fighter.
Enum
A named int; last_result stores the int, the screen matches the names.
Game clock
Milliseconds since the engine started; the same clock the arena's cool-down uses, so healing and reaction agree with firing.
Healing delay
Marks the shot time, so healing waits 3 s after the last shot as well as after the last hit.
Place rule
S8's place: the fighters still in when the player is out, plus 1. Here fighters_left() is read after the player's _alive entry was cleared.
Pure layout data
The canyon as data (spec 06 D2), so a rule can ask "is this point free" without a physics query.
RID
The physics server's id of a body; PhysicsRayQueryParameters3D.exclude takes a list of them.
RandomNumberGenerator
A seedable generator; one per match is shared by the brains, so a test with a fixed seed sees the same choices.
Ray query exclude
Bodies the ray ignores; here only the shooter, so other fighters are hit.
Rect2
An axis-aligned rectangle; grow(-0.6) shrinks the arena bounds so random points keep clear of the border.
Screen constant
res://scenes/match.tscn, the inheriting scene of the arena (D1).
Screens autoload
One constant per screen path and go_to; there is no screen stack (spec 04).
See-through
FighterModel swaps in alpha copies of its materials (spec 06 D11); now for every fighter in a bush (S6).
Sentinel value
Vector2.INF marks "do not fire", the same value Combat.release_aim already returns.
Session state
The GameState autoload lives for the whole run but is not saved; reset() empties it for tests.
Signals
knocked_out_now tells the arena (puff) and MatchArena (Match.knock_out) without the fighter knowing either.
Static function
A function of the class, not of an instance; the result screen calls Match.ordinal without a match.
Template method
Arena returns true; MatchArena overrides it with Match.can_act(), so the countdown locks mouse, keys and sticks in one place.
Variant
GDScript's any-type; the target id is an int index or a caller's id, and null means no target.
match statement
GDScript's pattern match, like switch; here it picks the suffix of 1, 2 and 3 outside 11-13.
minf
Float minimum; healing never goes above max_health.
super
Calls the inherited Arena method, so the player's input and camera stay exactly those of Training (D1).
